The crystal ball guides me, the blackbird calls me. To this place I have come, our fates tangled and spun...

Hit a streak of bad luck? Cat gone missing? Need someone to check the feng shui in your shop? Then go see the Witch! With the Witch on the case, no question goes unanswered!

Deep in the gloom of the forest stands the Witch's House, home to Blackbird. Known to locals simply as the Witch. Her talent for Divination is as mysterious as it is powerful. Those who visit her describe a woman of few words and quiet poise, able to see the fate of all things in her crystal ball and guide lost souls back to the right path.

Beyond these whispers, no one knows much about her.

They say she first appeared in these lands centuries ago. Black birds are her emissaries, free to fly into the past or the future, and through them she knows every secret the world keeps...

Hankaku Street

Baihui Alley

A historic old town district named for the two great sea bridges that converge here. Affordable prices and an unhurried pace of life have earned Bridge Crossings the top spot on Hethereau's "most livable" list for years. That same laid-back charm is what keeps a handful of wonderfully odd little shops alive — places too quirky to turn a real profit, yet too beloved to disappear — tucked away in the quiet back streets like secrets only locals know.

Pink Pearl

Hethereau Skytower

Whitetail Ridge Road

Ghost Train Station

Hethereau's premier destination for a great weekend out. Miguel District boasts the city's largest stretch of natural scenery and its most iconic landmark — making it the default answer for locals asking, "What are we doing this weekend?" Take a stroll beneath the Skytower, paddle across Caltrop Lake in a boat, or surrender your afternoon (and paycheck) to the Noetic Bridge shopping district. It's hard to leave in a bad mood.

Azure Vista Station

Far from the noise of the city, Unheard Shores is the go-to escape for locals who need to breathe. The grand Imaginist arena anchors the district, regularly hosting concerts from the hottest stars around. But it's the natural scenery that keeps people coming back — whether you're pitching a tent up in the hills or hopping aboard the coastal rail line, where the cry of seagulls and the sound of the horn frame a stretch of blue that you won't find anywhere else.

Origami Market

Raindrop Court

Clement Academy

Residents point to Illusion Town as having the best vibe in all of Hethereau. The Tamamochi Market Street is packed with charming little shops that are easy on the wallet — a favorite haunt for students and tourists alike. And if you're the type who's drawn to the strange and unexplained, head over to the fountain in Nacupeda Park and toss in a coin. Something unexpected just might happen.

Downtown New Herland

Nautili Tunnel

New Herland Streetview

The city's gleaming financial core, where corporate towers dominate the skyline and some of the biggest names in business have planted their flags. New Herland is home to Hethereau's wealthiest residents and most powerful players — and to the most lucrative, cutthroat Anomaly Hunter market in the entire city. If you're serious about money — earning it, spending it, or chasing it through Anomalies — this is where the real game is played.
